newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles transit agency appoints new executive.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles transit agency appoints new executive.

text.p: Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority Chief Executive Officer Joseph Drew said on Monday that he appointed Michal Robinson as the executive officer for administration, effective October 14.

Currently, Robinson is the district engineer and commander of the Los Angeles district for the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, where he has been responsible for water resources development, as well as military construction.
Robinson replaces Terry Matsumoto, who now becomes executive officer of finance.
